summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: @ornikar/eslint-config-formatjs@24.0.4 declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmod+x's it in a temp directory, and uses it to execute a 727KB obfuscated sibling bundle `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. If a local `bun` binary is already available, `setup.mjs` invokes it against `math_init.js` immediately without downloading. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` use obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (`_0xNNNN`) and string-array rotation (`WV8StW` cycling a large constant table). The package's declared purpose is an ESLint config for formatjs, which requires no alternate runtime and no compiled bundle. The alternate-runtime dispatch pattern executes the obfuscated payload outside Node's visibility and fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
